entities.summary: The chronology of the universe describes the history and future of the universe according to Big Bang cosmology. The history begins 13.863 billion years ago when the universe was extremely dense and hot, before any matter formed. The earliest stage in physical models is a vast expansion of space in a tiny fraction of a microsecond, followed by a slower expansion and the creation of matter and antimatter particles. These particles almost completely annihilate each other leaving energy and a small remainder of matter in the form of a quarks-gluon plasma.
